title: 十三张全垒打结算动画关键帧
intendedUse: 4×4 序列关键帧图集，裁成 16 帧后输出透明 AVIF 与 Pixi 帧序列；表现战胜其余全部玩家的奖励
prompt: Create an exact 4-column by 4-row transparent sprite sheet of 16 sequential frames for a Shisanshui full-table sweep celebration. Animate a tasteful fan-shaped halo of ivory and warm-gold light with small teal diamond sparks: frames 1-3 a tiny central glint, frames 4-7 a clean semicircular halo opens, frames 8-10 the halo reaches a celebratory peak with a few controlled star sparks, frames 11-14 the light disperses gently, frames 15-16 become transparent. Same center and scale per cell, no crossing boundaries. Transparent background. Premium game result flourish, festive but restrained. No player faces, no cards, no text, no numerical score; code controls the result and multiplier.
negativePrompt: text, letters, numbers, multiplier, panels, cards, suit symbols, characters, confetti covering a large area, background, grid lines, gutters, borders, effects touching neighboring cells, changing camera, inconsistent pivots, casino chips, harsh bloom, photorealism, watermark, logo

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match the established effect texture/color; the animation is a new fan-shaped celebration.
